text: Course Overview: Information and Communication Engineering is a first-level discipline, with two second-level disciplines: Communication and Information System, and Signal and Information Processing. This major covers numerous high-tech fields such as wireless communication, multimedia and image processing, electromagnetic fields and microwaves, medical X-ray digital imaging, array signal processing and phase space wave propagation and imaging, as well as satellite mobile video.Training Objectives: To cultivate scientific research and engineering professionals in the field of information and communication engineering, as well as faculty members for higher education institutions. Students are required to have a solid foundation in signal theory and communication systems, possess systematic specialized knowledge and necessary experimental skills, be familiar with the scientific and technological development trends in their research fields, and master a foreign language.
